editorial_guards: All eight artifacts are DRAFT (not LIVE) and have exact Blogger GET readback
Editorial rewrites retain factual guardrails, and avoid copying commercial links/photos from old site
No affiliate link or image is transferred; any commercial publication requires campaign/SKU verification
Source blogs remain publicly intact; none have canonical redirects across Blogspot verified
Search Console backlink/traffic coverage unavailable for most origins; deletion may lose SEO value
Old store workflows freeze in separate branch pending PR merge and CI
Post-specific permission required for LIVE by project policy
Manual deletion by owner only after reviewing backup, drafts and migration risk
